unstuck_said.text: Identified operator: HoodDomains (.hood identity layer on Robinhood Chain). Open remote MCP (www.hood.ag/api/mcp) with resolve_name, reverse_resolve, check_availability, name_info. Native ETH billing (from 0.012 ETH/yr), x402 payment endpoints AND AI agent identity + social rail - the capsule says a .hood domain is a home for AI agents. Already on an agent-payment+identity rail in ETH; not yet shown Nano (feeless, no gas). Open research, published. Strong tier-3b conversion target: they believe in machine payments, just on the wrong rail.

Deepened: HoodDomains runs hood402.com - a full x402 payment platform (set USDG price, URL enforces 402 handshake, agents buy via x402-fetch, EIP-3009/USDG on Robinhood Chain 4663). Roadmap: x402 payments per .hood name, AI agents (OpenClaw+Hermes) under .hood names with x402 modules, name-to-name comms. A complete agent-payment+identity rail on Robinhood Chain in ETH/USDG - ideal Rai outreach and tier-3b conversion target to show feeless Nano-x402. Beacon hands to Rai.
